descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S07a 「记事本和表在哪显示：医院有 Quick Dictation，养老院没有，口述到一半切过去也没有；开关关着时 Rounding Sheet 隐藏」 Where the pad and the sheet show: Quick Dictation in Hospital, absent in Nursing Home even mid-dictation; the Rounding Sheet hidden with the flag off

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U8 Quick Dictation is Hospital only and is absent in Nursing Home.（UAT TC-04；TFA-92582 AC 8）
  • U4 An unassigned box stays on the pad after Quick Dictation is closed and reopened, as the physician's own log. Boxes are never silently dropped. (The UAT says 'stays on the sheet'; …（UAT TC-04；TFA-92582 AC 5；TFA-92582 step 5；TFA-92583 AC 4）
  • T3 Quick Dictation is the pad only: the separate Rounding Sheet view (patients with open tasks, today's assigned compartments, 'Needs patient') is hidden, not deleted, so it can be turned back on.（TFA-92583 AC 5；TFA-92583 AC 4；TFA-92583 AC 1）

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Tim's chromium tests on a build with VITE_SHOW_ROUNDING_SHEET unset (default): Hospital list with the pad open and text typed, a care-context user, a patient with an open task

When Switch to Nursing Home with the pad open; open /rounding/sheet directly; walk every rounding-list navigation control

Then Quick Dictation visible in Hospital before the switch, absent in Nursing Home (no dialog, button or title); what was typed before the switch is kept on the server; /rounding/sheet lands on /rounding with no 'Rounding Sheet' heading; the list has no 'Rounding Sheet' button

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions: title /Quick Dictation/ visible on /rounding before the switch, dialog / button / title count 0 on /snf (U8); quickDictation:list equals the typed text (U4); URL /rounding and heading count 0 for /rounding/sheet, getByTitle(/Rounding Sheet/) toHaveCount(0) on the list (T3, hidden). …

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S07a 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-04.matrix.json 里的编号；字母后缀 = 一个用例拆成了几条），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：测试问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92582 ready for qa；TFA-92583 ready for qa

对医生来说没问题（快速口述只在医院出现、养老院没有，Rounding Sheet 已隐藏）；是我们 9/30 写的测试超时了：全屏的口述面板挡住了医院/养老院切换按钮。

Nothing is wrong for the physician (Quick Dictation shows in Hospital and not in Nursing Home, and the Rounding Sheet is hidden); our own 9/30 test timed out because the full-screen pad covers the Hospital/Nursing Home switch.

依据：Lane A, quick-dictation.spec.ts: test out of date (one of the six). Bisected 7f3907f^, 5d83248^ and 5d83248 on an isolated stack: no regression. All three navigation.spec.ts tests pass. Fix: close the pad before the switch.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：STATIC · 静态检查（构建产物 / 扫描） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
